Q5922.reason: Coring is when the needle cuts out fragments of the rubber bung while drawing drugs from a sealed vial.

Q5927.reason: Jaundice, spider naevi and purpura point to chronic liver disease, often alcohol-related. The liver enlarges from the right hypochondrium and is dull to percussion, and emphysema only displaces the liver downwards.

Q5930.reason: When the man took title to the woman's house he owned both the dominant and servient estates, so the easement ended by merger. It was not revived when he later conveyed the house, because the deed did not expressly grant it.
